title: MultiAirDropSBT
tagline: You can airdrop SBTs as ERC1155 to mulitaddress. If you are master of a event, an event is attached to one ID.
description:
This product allows you to airdrop SBTs (custom tokens) as ERC-1155 tokens to multiple addresses. ERC-1155 is a token standard on the Ethereum blockchain that supports multiple token types in a single contract, enabling efficient batch transfers and reducing gas costs.

As the master of an event, you can associate each event with a unique ID. By doing so, you can manage and distribute different types of tokens or rewards for different events, all within the same contract. This functionality makes the product an ideal solution for event organizers, promoters, or projects looking to distribute various tokens or digital assets to their participants or community members in a seamless and efficient manner.
how_its_made:
This product is developed using the Ethereum blockchain and is based on the ERC-1155 token standard, which supports multiple token types within a single smart contract. The design allows for efficient batch transfers, significantly reducing gas costs compared to individual transfers.

To create this product, developers have built a smart contract that enables event masters to associate each event with a unique ID. This allows them to manage and distribute various types of tokens or rewards for different events, all within the same contract. The result is a user-friendly and versatile tool, perfect for event organizers, promoters, and projects that aim to seamlessly and efficiently distribute tokens or digital assets to participants or community members.
